mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees and overcast near the Verona Public Library. We have a full moon tonight. The ISS will pass overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 32 degrees with no rain predicted.

If you are interested in the 2027 Spring Election, candidate packets are now available at the City Clerk's office on Lincoln Street. Remember, all candidacy paperwork must be submitted by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027. Also, remember that property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15, and you can view them online via Access Dane.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher special at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, join the fun at The Bogey Factory for trivia night, check out the opening of ART House 360, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia.

Regarding local safety, on November 6, officers were dispatched to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unconscious in a vehicle. The driver was subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant is currently open, so you have plenty of time to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
